### 🚀 Project Submission Checklist

Thank you for contributing your project to the **RIT Campus Open Source Radar**! Please verify the following before submitting:

- [ ] My project is open-source and public on GitHub.
- [ ] My repository contains a clear `README.md` and an open-source license (e.g. MIT, Apache 2.0, GPL).
- [ ] I created a new markdown file inside `content/projects/<my-project-name>.md`.
- [ ] I properly filled out all fields in the YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`, `repo_url`, `tech_stack`, `author`, `batch`).
- [ ] I verified that the `repo_url` points directly to my repository.
